name: Kinetiq kHYPE
description: Kinetiq's non-custodial liquid staking for HYPE on Hyperliquid. Stake HYPE on HyperEVM to receive kHYPE, a yield-bearing ERC-20 that appreciates against HYPE. An agent can stake HYPE, queue and confirm withdrawals, read the HYPE to kHYPE rate, and hold or trade kHYPE.

keyFunctions.description: Stake HYPE sent as msg.value and mint kHYPE to the caller. Check minStakeAmount(), maxStakeAmount(), stakingLimit() and isWhitelisted(msg.sender) first.
Queue an unstake of the given kHYPE amount. Starts the withdrawal delay. Read the new withdrawal ID with nextWithdrawalId(address) and pass it to confirmWithdrawal.
Claim the HYPE for a queued withdrawal ID once the withdrawal delay has passed.
Next withdrawal ID for an address.
Withdrawal request details for an address and withdrawal ID.
Delay before a queued withdrawal can be confirmed. Kinetiq's docs describe it as about 8 to 9 days.

actions.name: stake
actions.how: Call STAKING_MANAGER.stake() with HYPE as msg.value on HyperEVM (chain 999), after checking minStakeAmount(), maxStakeAmount() and isWhitelisted().

actions.name: unstake
actions.how: kHYPE.approve(STAKING_MANAGER, amount), then STAKING_MANAGER.queueWithdrawal(amount). After withdrawalDelay() passes, call confirmWithdrawal(withdrawalId).

actions.name: read-rate
actions.description: Read the HYPE to kHYPE rate

actions.name: exit-early
actions.how: Trade kHYPE on a DEX. Price can differ from the rate and depends on liquidity.

risks: Unstaking is delayed. Kinetiq's docs describe a wait of about 8 to 9 days before confirmWithdrawal can run.
An unstake fee applies (unstakeFeeRate). Read it on-chain before quoting an exit.
Staking can be limited: there are minimum and maximum amounts, a protocol staking limit, and a whitelist check. stake() can revert.
HYPE is delegated to validators chosen through the VALIDATOR_MANAGER. Validator performance affects the rate.
Contracts are controlled by Kinetiq. Upgrade and admin powers are not documented on the pages read.
notes: All four contracts are listed from Kinetiq's official integration page. Each has bytecode on HyperEVM. Chain ID 999 confirmed with eth_chainId on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm. The kHYPE token is an ERC-20. Cross-chain staking from Ethereum or Base is available through Kinetiq's app (Enso), not through these contracts. VALIDATOR_MANAGER has no key functions because its ABI was not on the pages read.
